summary: Compact rectangular motor controller in a dark finned enclosure. The top face has diagonal heat-sink ridges and three small LED indicators (ER, S1, S2) near one end. The opposite short end face carries a micro USB port and a 2x5 pin control header (CTRL, pins 1-10). A bundle of power and motor wires exits the back short end.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the enclosure, presumed to be the base mounting surface. It is not directly visible in the images.
Top face with diagonal heat-sink fins, usable as a thermal contact or clearance surface.
Front short end face with USB port, CTRL header and LED labels. It must stay accessible.

notes: Bounds come from the supplied catalog dimensions (60 x 32.5 x 23.5 mm), which are flagged as unverified. No dimensioned drawing is visible in the images. The images show no mounting holes, so none are listed. Wire exit is on the -Y end. Wire length and the fin depth and pitch are not specified and are not modeled. The bounding box is centered on the part, with X as width, Y as length and Z as height.
